Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class NetworkConnections

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.NetworkConnections
public final class NetworkConnections extends Object
NetworkManager connection discovery and management for the control center.

Companion to NetworkStatus (which only reports the live link for the taskbar glyph): this seam lists the saved connections and can activate / deactivate them. The parsing, formatting and command-building are pure and unit-tested (parseConnections(java.lang.String), activateCommand(java.lang.String), deactivateCommand(java.lang.String), label(org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.NetworkConnections.Connection)); read(), activate(String) and deactivate(String) are thin probes over nmcli. On a host without NetworkManager every probe degrades to an empty result / false rather than throwing, so the panel shows "no connections" instead of failing.
